source_refs.note: 3. Eutrophication: a main subheading of 33.3 Common Water Pollutants, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 250-250.

blocks.text: Nutrient pollution ko eutrophication bhi kehte hain. Yeh tab hoti hai jab nutrients (paudon ki ghiza), khaas taur par nitrogen aur phosphorus, bohat zyada miqdar mein pani mein chale jate hain; yeh aam taur par kheton ke behte pani, ganday pani (wastewater) aur toofani barish ke pani se aate hain. Yeh nutrients paudon ke barhne ke liye zaroori hain, lekin aquatic environments (pani) mein in ki excess (zyadti) se algae bohat tezi se barhti hai, jise algal bloom kehte hain. Yeh blooms pani ke andar ke paudon tak dhoop pohanchne nahi dete. Jab algae mar kar galti hai to bohat si oxygen kharch hoti hai, aur hypoxic (kam oxygen wale) “dead zones” bante hain jahan aquatic life (pani ki zindagi) zinda nahi reh sakti. Eutrophication aquatic ecosystems ko bigarti hai, biodiversity kam karti hai, fisheries (machhli ke karobar) ko nuqsan deti hai, aur pani ko peene aur recreation (tafreeh) ke laiq nahi rehne deti. Peene ke pani mein zyada nitrate khaas taur par chhote bachon (infants) ke liye khatarnak hai: is se “Blue Baby Syndrome” (Methaemoglobinaemia) ho sakta hai, jis mein nitrates khoon ki oxygen le jane ki salahiyat kam kar dete hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch dabbe teeron se jure: zyada N aur P (khaad, sewage); algae ki tez barhotri (bloom); bloom dhoop rok leta hai; murda algae gal kar oxygen kharch karti; dead zone jahan aquatic life (pani ki zindagi) mar jati.
